title: Musa at the sea
hook: The sea in front. An army behind.

phrases.text: The sea in front of them… and Pharaoh's army behind.
Prophet Musa, peace be upon him, led the Children of Israel out of Egypt by night, as Allah commanded.
At sunrise, Pharaoh and his soldiers caught up with them.
When the two groups saw each other, Musa's companions cried: we will surely be overtaken!
But Musa answered with complete certainty.
Allah told him to strike the sea with his staff, and it split apart.
Each part stood like a great mountain.
And Allah saved Musa and everyone with him.
When every road looks closed, remember: your Lord is with you. Share this with someone who needs it.

caption:
The sea in front, an army behind… and Musa said: my Lord is with me 🌊
From Surah Ash-Shu'ara.
